markets.trend: Sustained, near-record mainland southbound buying of HK equities over the past year, with the 3 Sep print (+HK$33.95bn) marking a 7th straight day of net buying before moderating to +HK$1.28bn by 7 Sep. No print for 8-11 Sep (Fri close) or the weekend was retrieved this session.
markets.interpretation: For a book heavy in HK tech, persistent southbound buying (Tencent, Alibaba and other internet/tech names are perennial southbound favorites) is a structurally supportive flow backdrop. However this measures mainland demand only -- there is no way to read pure foreign/Western institutional sentiment toward HK from official data, which matters given HK tech's foreign-institutional ownership base.
dataGaps: No official HK retail-vs-institutional split exists at all. Real-time (intraday) Stock Connect turnover/quota disclosure remains curtailed since 2024 -- only daily (T+1) aggregate net flow is available, and none fresher than 7 Sep was retrieved this run. No EPFR/BofA-specific HK-only weekly fund-flow figure confirmed either.

markets.trend: Chinese retail/margin-driven risk appetite has run hot through most of 2026 (record margin balances, elevated turnover), consistent with a strong onshore rally narrative. Foreign (northbound) participation is now largely opaque in real time.
markets.interpretation: For a book heavy in HK tech: sustained mainland retail leverage and southbound buying (see Hong Kong entry) form a supportive flow backdrop for HK-listed tech/internet names funded by mainland money. But a record margin balance is also a classic late-cycle/froth signal -- a reversal in mainland retail sentiment (forced margin-call deleveraging) is a tail risk worth flagging for HK tech exposure specifically.
dataGaps: No official A-share retail/institutional trading split exists. Margin balance and new-account-opening data are the standard proxies, and even margin-balance figures are reported inconsistently across outlets. Northbound real-time flow disclosure has been discontinued since Aug 2024; only lagged monthly aggregates remain, none retrieved this session.
